plan.rule: Start from each observed best zero-cooling setup of the coarse grid, move1..6 points from exactly one available axis to cooling. Same total budget, fixed other settings, no coefficient change. Preregistered before evaluating these finer allocations.
plan.scope: Local single-donor refinement only; not a continuous global optimum. Preserve coarse and primary evidence and all failures.
